reason: The acquisition of Suguna Hospital for INR 277 crore expands the company's footprint in Bengaluru with immediate scale-up potential to 150 beds.
why_now: The acquisition was officially announced via exchange filing on October 28, 2026.
source_headlines: Fortis Healthcare Limited: Fortis Healthcare Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated October 28, 2026, titled "Fortis acquires 110-bedded Suguna Hospital, Rajajinagar, Bengaluru for approx. INR 277 Crs; facility provides further potential to scale up to 150 beds".
